guide.title: Unlock Loamm Niffen repeatable activities
guide.navigationPolicy: Positive native objective and quest-end waypoints are supported destinations. Fixed researched points are alternatives; do not reinterpret acceptance coordinates or scenario interior coordinates across maps.
guide.eligibilityPolicy: Conditions use current quest offers, quest log, completion and scenario evidence. Never require completion of both alternative breadcrumbs. Resume at the first unfinished eligible action, not an old cursor.

rewardCheckpoints.terminal: Toy Box ownership; prior quest completion does not prove the reward was received or learned.

guide.recoveryPolicy: A temporary repair returns to the original action only after its actual condition is established. Quest abandonment, gossip skips, reward selection and transports remain player-controlled.
guide.gapBoundary: The connected chapter is fully authored from a currently offered/active chapter quest. Availability of the fresh-character root before Hidden Legacies and exceptional global phase defects remain outside that completeness claim.
